info.name: Donexus
info.description:
Server-to-server API the **Calcite Hyper** system uses to manage **Donexus** (charity fundraising platform): tenants (lifecycle, comp, trial, their admin accounts), plans and the feature matrix, plan changes and overrides, billing (revenue, invoices, coupons), support tickets, the leads CRM, and the platform dashboard and audit log.

Import `Donexus-Local.postman_environment.json` (or a copy pointed at production) and select it — or drop the **Donexus** folder into the Hyper ecosystem collection and add `donexus_base_url` / `donexus_api_key` to that environment. Auth is `x-api-key`, configured on the **Donexus** folder.

Create requests save ids into collection variables (`donexusTenantId`, `donexusPlanCode`, `donexusForkPlanCode`, `donexusTicketId`, `donexusAssigneeId`, `donexusCouponCode`, `donexusLeadId`, …), so the folder runs top-to-bottom. They are prefixed so they don't collide with the Hyyve/Stewardex variables in a shared collection.

item.name: Donexus
item.description:
Donexus (charity fundraising platform) — integration API.

**Base:** `{{donexus_base_url}}/integration` · **Auth:** `x-api-key: {{donexus_api_key}}` (set on this folder). Optional `x-actor-email` (added from the `actor_email` environment variable by this folder's pre-request script) records the person behind a call in the audit log as `integration:<key name> (<email>)`.
Responses: `{ success: true, data, meta?, warnings? }` / `{ success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }`. Unknown body fields are refused (`UNKNOWN_FIELD`). Field names are snake_case; dates ISO 8601 UTC; money in whole units with a `currency`.

exec: // Attribute the call to a person in the Donexus audit log (optional).

request.description:
Checks the API key. Returns `{ service: "donexus", key, actor, time }` — `key` is the **name** half of the matched `INTEGRATION_API_KEYS` pair (e.g. `hyper`), never the secret; `actor` echoes `x-actor-email` when sent. Runs the real auth middleware, so it is the smoke test after a deploy or key rotation.

| situation | response |
|---|---|
| valid key | 200 |
| no `x-api-key` | 401 `API_KEY_MISSING` |
| unknown key | 401 `API_KEY_INVALID` |
| malformed `x-actor-email` | 400 `INVALID_ACTOR_EMAIL` |
| `INTEGRATION_API_KEYS` unset on the server | 503 `INTEGRATION_DISABLED` |

item.name: Tenants
item.description: Tenant (Donexus **organisation** — a charity with its own subdomain) CRUD. **Delete = soft delete** (status `deleted`, Stripe subscription cancelled, data kept). Suspended and deleted tenants can't sign in or use tenant-scoped calls until reactivated. `:id` accepts the tenant id or its slug.

query.description: Optional: active | suspended | pending | deleted | all. Default: everything except deleted.
Optional: only tenants on this plan
Optional: case-insensitive match on name or slug

request.description:
Every tenant, newest first, **with its subscription inline** — one call renders the whole table (plans, invoice periods and owners are resolved in a fixed number of queries, not per row).

**Paginated**: `meta: { page, limit, total, pages }`.

**Tenant object**
| field | notes |
|---|---|
| `id` | Mongo ObjectId. Every `/tenants/:id` route also accepts the `slug`. |
| `name`, `slug` | `slug` is the subdomain (`<slug>.<domain>`); it never changes. |
| `status` | `active` \| `suspended` \| `deleted` \| `pending`. `pending` = a self-serve signup that never completed its first card payment (no owner account yet). `suspended` also covers tenants whose Stripe subscription was cancelled by Stripe. |
| `portal_url`, `contact_email`, `is_muslim_charity` | |
| `owner` | `{ id, name, email }` of the tenant's primary admin, or null. |
| `has_override` | true when a per-tenant override is set. |
| `subscription.plan_code` / `plan_name` / `plan_status` | `plan_status` is `active` or `archived` (a tenant can stay on an archived plan). |
| `subscription.billing_cycle` | `monthly` \| `yearly` |
| `subscription.status` | Donexus billing state: `pending` \| `active` \| `past_due` \| `cancelled` |
| `subscription.billing` | who pays: `stripe` (live platform Stripe subscription) \| `comp` (free) \| `none` (nothing bills it) |
| `subscription.is_comp`, `comp_reason`, `trial_ends_at` | `trial_ends_at` is informational — nothing locks the tenant when it passes. |
| `subscription.current_period` | `{ start, end }` of the latest paid platform invoice if it covers today, else null. `last_paid_period` is the same without the "covers today" rule. |
| `subscription.price` | `{ currency, amount, source }` for the current cycle; `source` = `override` \| `plan` \| `none`. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `deleted_at` | ISO 8601 UTC |

Single-tenant responses add `override` (see *Set tenant override*), `entitlements: { feature_flags, limits }` (the effective result of plan + override; a `null` limit = unlimited), and — on *Get tenant* only — `recent_events` (last 20 audit events) and `recent_invoices` (last 10).

exec: if (res.data && res.data.id !== undefined && res.data.id !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set("donexusTenantId", res.data.id); console.log("donexusTenantId =", res.data.id); }

if (res.data && res.data.owner && res.data.owner.id !== undefined && res.data.owner && res.data.owner.id !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set("donexusAssigneeId", res.data.owner && res.data.owner.id); console.log("donexusAssigneeId =", res.data.owner && res.data.owner.id); }

request.description:
Provisions an organisation and its owner (admin) user — the same provisioning as the Donexus console's Leads → Convert. 201 with the tenant (as *Get tenant*) plus `welcome_email` and `credentials`. Saves `{{donexusTenantId}}` and `{{donexusAssigneeId}}` (the owner).

| field | required | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `organization_name` | yes | ≤200 chars (`organisation_name` also accepted) |
| `email` | yes | owner's login. **Unique across the whole platform**, not per tenant → 409 `EMAIL_IN_USE` |
| `first_name` (+ `last_name`) | yes | or a single `name` |
| `password` | no | 8–128 chars. **If omitted, one is generated and returned once** as `credentials.generated_password` (never emailed, never retrievable later) |
| `slug` | no | subdomain; derived from the name when omitted. 3–63 chars, lowercase letters/digits/single hyphens → 400 `INVALID_SLUG`, 409 `SLUG_TAKEN` |
| `plan_code` | no | default `essentials`. 404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `PLAN_ARCHIVED` |
| `billing_cycle` | no | `monthly` (default) \| `yearly` |
| `trial_days` | no | 1–365 → `subscription.trial_ends_at` (informational) |
| `is_comp` | no | default **true** |
| `comp_reason`, `is_muslim_charity` | no | `is_muslim_charity` enables the Islamic giving pages + donation types |
| `send_welcome_email` | no | default **true** |
| `reason` | no | audit note |

**Side effects:** tenant is active immediately; default website pages and donation types are seeded; `org.provisioned` audit event. With `send_welcome_email` the owner is emailed the portal URL and login link, plus a 7-day *set your password* link when the password was generated (`credentials.set_password_url` is that same link, returned once).

**Billing:** Donexus self-serve signup takes a card in the browser, which a server-to-server call can't do — a tenant created here has **no Stripe subscription** and is never charged automatically. With `is_comp: false` you get a `NOT_BILLED` warning.

Tenant detail incl. subscription, override, effective entitlements, the last 20 audit events (`recent_events`, from the console or this API) and the last 10 platform invoices. Deleted tenants are returned (status `deleted`).

**Tenant object**
| field | notes |
|---|---|
| `id` | Mongo ObjectId. Every `/tenants/:id` route also accepts the `slug`. |
| `name`, `slug` | `slug` is the subdomain (`<slug>.<domain>`); it never changes. |
| `status` | `active` \| `suspended` \| `deleted` \| `pending`. `pending` = a self-serve signup that never completed its first card payment (no owner account yet). `suspended` also covers tenants whose Stripe subscription was cancelled by Stripe. |
| `portal_url`, `contact_email`, `is_muslim_charity` | |
| `owner` | `{ id, name, email }` of the tenant's primary admin, or null. |
| `has_override` | true when a per-tenant override is set. |
| `subscription.plan_code` / `plan_name` / `plan_status` | `plan_status` is `active` or `archived` (a tenant can stay on an archived plan). |
| `subscription.billing_cycle` | `monthly` \| `yearly` |
| `subscription.status` | Donexus billing state: `pending` \| `active` \| `past_due` \| `cancelled` |
| `subscription.billing` | who pays: `stripe` (live platform Stripe subscription) \| `comp` (free) \| `none` (nothing bills it) |
| `subscription.is_comp`, `comp_reason`, `trial_ends_at` | `trial_ends_at` is informational — nothing locks the tenant when it passes. |
| `subscription.current_period` | `{ start, end }` of the latest paid platform invoice if it covers today, else null. `last_paid_period` is the same without the "covers today" rule. |
| `subscription.price` | `{ currency, amount, source }` for the current cycle; `source` = `override` \| `plan` \| `none`. |
| `created_at`, `updated_at`, `deleted_at` | ISO 8601 UTC |

Single-tenant responses add `override` (see *Set tenant override*), `entitlements: { feature_flags, limits }` (the effective result of plan + override; a `null` limit = unlimited), and — on *Get tenant* only — `recent_events` (last 20 audit events) and `recent_invoices` (last 10).

**Errors:** 404 `TENANT_NOT_FOUND`.

Body: `name` and/or `status` (`active` \| `suspended` \| `deleted`), optional `reason` for the audit log. Returns tenant detail plus `changed` (false when nothing actually changed — same-value writes are no-ops, not errors). The slug never changes.

Takes effect immediately and completely:
1. Every tenant-scoped API request answers 402.
2. Sign-in is refused for the tenant's admins **and donors** (403).
3. Existing staff sessions are revoked, so a later reactivation doesn't revive them.
4. The platform Stripe subscription is cancelled, if live. If Stripe fails, access is still locked and a `STRIPE_CANCEL_FAILED` warning says billing may continue.

The Donexus backend keeps no tenant cache, so there is nothing to clear. Idempotent (`changed: false` when already suspended).

**Errors:** 409 `TENANT_PENDING_PAYMENT` (a signup that never paid).

Restores a suspended **or deleted** tenant. Logins and API access work again; staff sign in afresh.

**Billing is not restarted.** A Stripe subscription cancelled by suspend/delete stays cancelled (Stripe cancellations are final): the tenant comes back with `subscription.billing: "none"` unless comped, and the response carries a `BILLING_NOT_RESTARTED` warning. Re-assigning a plan doesn't restart card billing either.

**Errors:** 409 `TENANT_PENDING_PAYMENT` / `TENANT_HAS_NO_OWNER`.

**Soft delete — an offboarding, never a purge.** Status `deleted`, same effects as *Suspend tenant* (API + logins blocked, sessions revoked, Stripe subscription cancelled), hidden from the default list. **All data is kept** (donors, orders, invoices, pages, audit trail). `reason` in the body or as `?reason=`.

Restore with `PATCH { "status": "active" }` — or `"suspended"` to undelete without reopening. See *Reactivate tenant* for billing.

**Errors:** 409 `TENANT_ALREADY_DELETED`.
Same call as *Reactivate tenant*, on a deleted tenant: `deleted_at` is cleared and the audit event is `org.restored`. Leaves the tenant active so the folders below can run.

query.description: Optional: draft | open | paid | failed | void | uncollectible
Optional: created on/before; a date-only value includes that whole day

request.description: The platform invoices Donexus has billed this tenant, newest first. Same shape and totals as *Billing → List invoices*. A tenant created through this API has no Stripe subscription, so the list is usually empty for it.

exec: pm.test("provisioning is in the history", () => pm.expect(res.data.map((e) => e.action)).to.include("org.provisioned"));

request.description: Every operator action on this tenant, from the Donexus console **and** this API, newest first. Paginated (*Get tenant* only carries the last 20). Entry shape as *Platform → Audit log*.

**Always 403 `IMPERSONATION_NOT_ALLOWED`.** Signing in as a tenant mints a session and must be tied to a named person, so it stays in the Donexus console (*Open as support*, with its kill switch and per-action audit). Listed so the refusal is explicit, as in Stewardex.

item.name: Tenant admins
item.description:
A charity's own **admin accounts** (the people who sign in to its Donexus admin portal) — what Calcite support is asked to do when someone can't get in, or shouldn't be able to. The same actions as the Donexus console's *Team → Tenant admins*.

- `:userId` must be an admin **of that tenant** — an id from another tenant, a donor or a platform operator is 404 `TENANT_ADMIN_NOT_FOUND`.
- These act on **one person**. To lock the whole charity, use *Tenants → Suspend tenant*.
- Nothing here sets a password or creates an admin: *Send password reset* emails a link only their inbox can open.
- `reason` (optional) is recorded in the audit log on every write.

request.description:
Every admin account of the tenant with its sign-in state. `meta.total` is the count.

**Admin object**: `id`, `name`, `email`, `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `status` (`active` \| `suspended`), `two_factor_enabled`, `mfa_policy` (`default` \| `required`), `mfa_required`, `locked_until` (set only while a failed-sign-in lockout is in force), `last_login_at`, `created_at`. Action responses add `message`.

One admin. `{{donexusAssigneeId}}` is the tenant owner (set by *Create tenant*).

**Admin object**: `id`, `name`, `email`, `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `status` (`active` \| `suspended`), `two_factor_enabled`, `mfa_policy` (`default` \| `required`), `mfa_required`, `locked_until` (set only while a failed-sign-in lockout is in force), `last_login_at`, `created_at`. Action responses add `message`.

**Errors:** 400 (malformed id), 404 `TENANT_ADMIN_NOT_FOUND`.

`{ status: "suspended" | "active", mfa_policy?: "default" | "required", reason? }` — send either or both; both are validated before either is written.

**Suspend** takes effect immediately: sign-in is refused and every live session is signed out. The charity's website, donation pages and donors are **not** affected.
**Reactivate** (`"active"`) also clears any failed-sign-in lockout and retires tokens issued before the suspension.

`mfa_policy: "required"` makes two-factor **mandatory** for this admin: if they haven't enrolled, their next sign-in holds them on the set-up screen. It can't switch two-factor on for them — that needs their authenticator. `"default"` = not required.
Back to the default (not required). Leaves the owner usable for the folders below.
Clears the lockout that five failed sign-ins apply (otherwise it lifts after 15 minutes). `locked_until` becomes null. Safe to call when not locked.
Ends every session for this admin without changing the account — for a lost device or a shared login. They can sign straight back in with their password.

**Removes** two-factor from the account so the admin can sign in with their password and enrol a new authenticator ("new phone, codes gone"). Also signs out every session. The most sensitive action here — confirm identity first; it's audited by name.

**Errors:** 409 `MFA_NOT_ENABLED` when two-factor isn't on (the case for a freshly provisioned owner, so this request accepts 409).

Emails the admin a one-hour *reset your password* link on **their charity's portal**. Calcite never sees or sets the password.

**Errors:** 409 `TENANT_ADMIN_SUSPENDED` (reactivate first), 409 `NO_PORTAL_ADDRESS`, 502 `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED` (the SMTP send failed; nothing was changed that the admin would notice — this request accepts 502 for local runs without SMTP).

item.name: Plans
item.description: Subscription plan catalogue, synced to the platform Stripe account. The default tiers (`essentials`, `professional`, `enterprise`) are real plan documents created by `npm run seed:plans` — Donexus has no unsaved in-code templates, so there is no "materialise" step. Every save is audited with a field-level diff (`revisions[].diff` on *Get plan*). **Delete = archive** (plans are referenced by tenants). Plan codes: 3–40 chars, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (no underscores).

request.description:
Every plan, ordered by `sort_order`. Unpaginated (the catalogue is small); `meta.total` is the count.

**Plan object**: `code`, `name`, `description`, `status` (`active` \| `archived`), `archived_at`, `is_public` (shown on the public pricing page), `is_popular`, `sort_order`, `color`, `pricing: { currency, monthly, yearly, onboarding_fee }` (whole currency units; currency is platform-wide, `AUD`), `limits` (limit code → number, `null` = unlimited), `feature_flags` (flag code → boolean), `marketing_features` (pricing-card bullets, display only), `stripe_synced`, `subscribers: { total, active }`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

Keys inside `limits` and `feature_flags` are the `code`s from *Feature flags*, passed verbatim (camelCase, e.g. `eventsQuota`, `adminSeats`). Unknown codes are refused (`UNKNOWN_LIMIT_KEY` / `UNKNOWN_FEATURE_FLAG`).

exec: if (res.data && res.data.code !== undefined && res.data.code !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set("donexusPlanCode", res.data.code); console.log("donexusPlanCode =", res.data.code); }

request.description:
Create a plan. 201 with the plan detail (as *Get plan*). Saves `{{donexusPlanCode}}`.

| field | required | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | 3–40 chars, lowercase letters/digits/hyphens; stable forever — it is what `assign-plan` takes |
| `name` | yes | ≤120 chars |
| `fork_from` | no | copy another plan — see *Fork plan* |
| `description` | no | ≤500 chars |
| `pricing` | no | `{ monthly, yearly, onboarding_fee }`, ≥0, max 2 dp. `currency` may be sent but must be the platform currency (`CURRENCY_MISMATCH`). A cycle priced 0 has no Stripe price. |
| `limits`, `feature_flags` | no | codes from *Feature flags* |
| `marketing_features` | no | ≤30 strings |
| `is_public` (default true), `is_popular`, `sort_order`, `color` (`#rrggbb`) | no | |
| `reason` | no | audit |

Not in Donexus plans (refused as `UNKNOWN_FIELD`): trial days and support terms — trials are set per tenant (`trial_days` on *Create tenant*).

**Side effects:** creates a Stripe Product + Prices. If Stripe is down the plan still saves, `stripe_synced` is false and a `STRIPE_NOT_SYNCED` warning is returned.

**Errors:** 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `INVALID_PLAN_CODE` / `UNKNOWN_FIELD` / `UNKNOWN_LIMIT_KEY` / `UNKNOWN_FEATURE_FLAG`, 409 `PLAN_CODE_TAKEN`.

exec: if (res.data && res.data.code !== undefined && res.data.code !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set("donexusForkPlanCode", res.data.code); console.log("donexusForkPlanCode =", res.data.code); }

request.description:
Bespoke plan copied from another. `fork_from` copies **description, pricing (both cycles + onboarding fee), limits, feature_flags, marketing_features and color**; anything in the body wins — `pricing` merged per cycle, `limits` / `feature_flags` merged per key over the copy. A fork defaults to `is_public: false` so a customer-specific plan never shows on the public pricing page. Saves `{{donexusForkPlanCode}}`.

**Errors:** 404 `FORK_SOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, plus everything *Create plan* returns.

Plan + history.

**Plan object**: `code`, `name`, `description`, `status` (`active` \| `archived`), `archived_at`, `is_public` (shown on the public pricing page), `is_popular`, `sort_order`, `color`, `pricing: { currency, monthly, yearly, onboarding_fee }` (whole currency units; currency is platform-wide, `AUD`), `limits` (limit code → number, `null` = unlimited), `feature_flags` (flag code → boolean), `marketing_features` (pricing-card bullets, display only), `stripe_synced`, `subscribers: { total, active }`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

Keys inside `limits` and `feature_flags` are the `code`s from *Feature flags*, passed verbatim (camelCase, e.g. `eventsQuota`, `adminSeats`). Unknown codes are refused (`UNKNOWN_LIMIT_KEY` / `UNKNOWN_FEATURE_FLAG`).

- `price_history[]`: `{ monthly, yearly, replaced_at }`, newest first. Stripe prices are immutable, so a price change mints a new Stripe Price.
- `revisions[]`: last 50 — `{ id, action, actor, at, diff, reason }`. `diff` is field-level, e.g. `{ "price.monthly": { "from": 149, "to": 119 }, "limits.adminSeats": { "from": 5, "to": 25 } }`. `actor` is `integration:<key> (<x-actor-email>)` for calls through this API.

**Errors:** 404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`.

Partial update of any of: `name`, `description`, `pricing`, `limits`, `feature_flags`, `marketing_features`, `is_public`, `is_popular`, `sort_order`, `color`, `status` (`active` \| `archived`), plus `reason`.

### ⚠ Nested objects MERGE — they are not replaced
(Donexus differs from Stewardex here, and uses the same semantics as its own console.)
- `limits`, `feature_flags`: **per key**. Keys you don't send keep their stored value. `null` makes a limit unlimited; there is no "remove this key".
- `pricing`: **per cycle**. `{ "yearly": 1390 }` leaves `monthly` and `onboarding_fee` untouched.
- `marketing_features`: **replaced** wholesale (it is a list).

`status: "archived"` archives exactly like *Delete (archive) plan* (send it alone, with `confirm: true` when tenants are still active on the plan); `status: "active"` restores an archived plan.

**Price changes:** a new Stripe Price is minted per changed cycle. **Existing paying tenants are NOT moved** — they keep the old price until migrated in the Donexus console (Plans → Migrate subscribers). Response: `price_changed`, `subscribers_on_previous_price`, and a `SUBSCRIBERS_GRANDFATHERED` warning when that is > 0. Limits and flags apply to every tenant on the plan immediately.

**Errors:** 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `UNKNOWN_FIELD` / `UNKNOWN_LIMIT_KEY` / `UNKNOWN_FEATURE_FLAG`, 404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`.

query.description: Required when tenants are still active on the plan

request.description:
Sets status `archived` (and `is_public: false`); archived plans can't be newly assigned (`assign-plan` → 409 `PLAN_ARCHIVED`). **Existing tenants keep working** on it, and Stripe subscriptions on it keep renewing. Response includes `active_subscriptions`.

With tenants still active on the plan: 409 `PLAN_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANTS` (`details.subscribersAffected`) — repeat with `?confirm=true`.

**Errors:** 404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `PLAN_HAS_ACTIVE_TENANTS` / `PLAN_ALREADY_ARCHIVED`.
Un-archives the plan: assignable again, Stripe Product/Prices re-enabled. `is_public` stays false until you set it. Leaves the plan active for *Subscriptions*.

Catalogue of the codes used in plan and override `feature_flags` / `limits` maps.
- `flags[]`: `{ code, category, name, description, core, vertical }`. `core: true` = always on, can't be switched off. `vertical: "muslim"` = only takes effect for tenants with `is_muslim_charity`.
- `limits[]`: `{ code, category, name, description, unit }` — numeric quotas, `null` = unlimited.
- `categories[]`: `{ code, name, description }`.

`volunteers` exists in **both** lists: the flag turns the feature on, the limit caps applications — independent.

Every plan's features and limits side by side — the Donexus console's *Features* screen, for a "which plan gets what" grid.

`{ categories[], flags[], limits[], plans: [{ code, name, status, is_public, sort_order, feature_flags, limits }] }`. `flags` / `limits` are the catalogue (as *Feature flags*); each plan's maps are keyed by those codes.

Turn features on/off and change limits for **several plans in one call**. `plans` is keyed by plan code; each entry takes `feature_flags` and/or `limits`.

- **Merges per key** into each named plan (same as *Update plan*). Plans you don't name are untouched.
- The **whole body is validated before any plan is saved**: an unknown plan (404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`), flag (`UNKNOWN_FEATURE_FLAG`) or limit (`UNKNOWN_LIMIT_KEY`) anywhere means nothing is written. Errors name the plan in `details.plan_code`.
- Applies to every tenant on those plans immediately (overrides still win). One `plan.entitlements_updated` audit event.

Response: `{ updated: [codes], plans: [matrix rows] }`.

After a price change, existing Stripe-billed tenants stay on the **old** price (`SUBSCRIBERS_GRANDFATHERED`). This moves every tenant on the plan onto its **current** Stripe price for their cycle.

`proration`: `none` (default — new price from the next renewal, nothing charged now) \| `create_prorations` (difference added to the next invoice) \| `always_invoice` (**invoices the difference immediately — moves money**).

Response: `{ plan_code, proration, migrated, failed, skipped }`. `skipped` = already on the price, or no Stripe price for their cycle. Warnings: `MIGRATION_PARTIAL` (some failed — retry), `STRIPE_UNAVAILABLE` (Stripe not configured; nothing moved). Comped / API-provisioned tenants have no Stripe subscription and aren't counted.

Creates or repairs the plan's Stripe Product and Prices — the fix for a plan with `stripe_synced: false` (e.g. saved while Stripe was down). Returns plan detail.

**Errors:** 503 `STRIPE_UNAVAILABLE` (Stripe not configured), 502 `STRIPE_UPDATE_FAILED` (Stripe refused; message says why). Accepts both for local runs.
Same as *Delete (archive) plan* — the admin-portal spelling. Body `{ confirm?, reason? }`.
Same as `PATCH { status: "active" }`. **Errors:** 409 `PLAN_NOT_ARCHIVED`.

item.name: Subscriptions (change plan)
item.description: Assign or change a tenant's plan and manage per-tenant overrides. Every call writes an audit event (see `recent_events` on *Get tenant*). In Donexus the subscription is part of the tenant (`subscription` on the tenant object), optionally backed by a platform Stripe subscription.

request.description:
Sets or changes the plan. `plan_code` required (must exist, not archived); `billing_cycle`: `monthly` \| `yearly` (default: the tenant's current cycle); `reason` optional.

### What it does to billing — warn staff before they click
- **Tenant has a live Stripe subscription** (`subscription.billing: "stripe"`): switched to the plan's Stripe Price **with prorations**, settled on the **next** invoice (nothing charged now). Same cycle keeps the renewal date; **a cycle change resets the billing period to today**. If Stripe rejects it, **nothing changes** (502 `STRIPE_UPDATE_FAILED`).
- **No live subscription** (comped, API-provisioned, or billing ended): only the stored plan/cycle change; the billing period is untouched.
- **Status is never changed** — unlike Stewardex, assigning a plan does not set the tenant active; a suspended tenant stays suspended.

Response: tenant + `changed` + `billing_sync: { status: "updated" | "skipped", reason?, proration?, billing_anchor_reset? }`.

**Errors:** 404 `PLAN_NOT_FOUND`, 409 `PLAN_ARCHIVED` / `TENANT_DELETED` / `PLAN_NOT_BILLABLE` (paying tenant → plan with no Stripe price for that cycle), 502 `STRIPE_UPDATE_FAILED`, 503 `STRIPE_UNAVAILABLE`.
Same endpoint — keep the plan, change the cycle. For a Stripe-billed tenant this **resets the billing period to today** and prorates. Sending the current plan and cycle is a no-op (`changed: false`).

Create/replace this tenant's override of plan limits, flags or pricing. **PUT replaces the whole override** — keys you leave out fall back to the plan.

| field | notes |
|---|---|
| `reason` | **required** → 400 `REASON_REQUIRED` |
| `limits` | limit code → integer ≥0, or `null` = unlimited |
| `feature_flags` | flag code → boolean. Core flags can't be switched off → 400 `CORE_FLAG_LOCKED` |
| `pricing` | `{ monthly, yearly }` in platform currency; `null` = plan price |
| `effective_from` / `effective_until` | **not supported in Donexus** → 400 `OVERRIDE_WINDOW_UNSUPPORTED`. An override applies from when it is set until cleared. |

**Effect:** limits and flags change the tenant's entitlements immediately. **`pricing` is a recorded negotiated price for MRR reporting and `subscription.price` — it does NOT change what Stripe charges.** To change a Stripe-billed tenant's actual price, fork a plan and assign it.

Response: tenant with `override: { limits, feature_flags, pricing, reason, set_by, set_at }` and resolved `entitlements`.
Removes the override; the tenant falls back to plan defaults. Returns tenant detail plus `cleared` (false when there was no override). `reason` optional (body or `?reason=`).

`{ is_comp: boolean, reason }` — `reason` is **required** when comping (400 `REASON_REQUIRED`).

This flag records **who pays**; it doesn't move money:
- Un-comping does **not** start a Stripe subscription. With none, you get a `NOT_BILLED` warning — nothing will charge the tenant automatically.
- Comping does **not** cancel a live Stripe subscription (`STRIPE_STILL_BILLING` warning).

Comped tenants count as subscribers but add nothing to MRR. Response: tenant + `changed`.

**Errors:** 409 `TENANT_DELETED`.
Marks the tenant free of charge. See *Remove comp* for what this does and doesn't do.

Send **exactly one** of:
- `extend_days` (1–365): added to the current `trial_ends_at`, or to **now** when there is no trial or it already passed.
- `trial_ends_at`: an ISO date (not in the past), or `null` to clear the trial.

Plus optional `reason`. Returns the tenant. **The trial is informational** — nothing locks the tenant when it ends.

item.name: Billing
item.description:
What Donexus bills its tenants: revenue summary, platform invoices (a mirror of the platform Stripe account, written by its webhook — read-only here), and discount coupons for the SaaS subscription checkout.

Donexus has no credit-note / void / retry-payment endpoints: those are done in the Stripe dashboard, and the resulting invoice state flows back into *List invoices* through the webhook.

request.description:
The console's *Billing* screen:

`{ currency, mrr, arr, collected_lifetime, tenants_total, subscriptions_active, subscriptions_comped, subscriptions_past_due, paying_by_cycle: { monthly, yearly }, plans: [{ code, name, subscribers, paying_subscribers, mrr, list_price: { monthly, yearly } }], recent_signups: [{ id, name, slug, plan_code, subscription_status, owner, created_at }] }`

**How MRR is calculated** (identical to the console, one shared implementation): active, non-comped tenants; yearly subscribers count as yearly price ÷ 12; a tenant with an override price counts at that price. Soft-deleted tenants are excluded. `collected_lifetime` = sum of paid platform invoices.

query.description: Optional: draft | open | paid | failed | void | uncollectible
Optional: invoice number, Stripe invoice id, or tenant name/slug
Optional: created on/before (date-only includes the whole day)

request.description:
Invoices across every tenant, newest first.

**Paginated**: `meta: { page, limit, total, pages, totals }`, where `totals` covers the **whole filtered set**, not just the page: `{ currency, paid_amount, paid_count, outstanding_amount, outstanding_count }` (outstanding = open + failed + uncollectible).

**Invoice object**: `id`, `number`, `status` (`draft` \| `open` \| `paid` \| `failed` \| `void` \| `uncollectible`), `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `currency`, `amount_due`, `amount_paid` (whole units), `period_start`, `period_end`, `paid_at`, `hosted_invoice_url` (Stripe's pay/view page), `invoice_pdf_url`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `stripe_subscription_id`, `created_at`.

One invoice, by Donexus id **or** Stripe invoice id (`in_…`).

**Invoice object**: `id`, `number`, `status` (`draft` \| `open` \| `paid` \| `failed` \| `void` \| `uncollectible`), `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `currency`, `amount_due`, `amount_paid` (whole units), `period_start`, `period_end`, `paid_at`, `hosted_invoice_url` (Stripe's pay/view page), `invoice_pdf_url`, `stripe_invoice_id`, `stripe_subscription_id`, `created_at`.

**Errors:** 400 (neither form of id), 404 `INVOICE_NOT_FOUND` (accepted here: a fresh local database has no invoices).

Every coupon, newest first. `times_redeemed` is refreshed from Stripe on each call. `meta: { total, stripe_enabled }`.

**Coupon object**: `code`, `description`, `type` (`percent` \| `amount`), `value` (1–100, or whole currency units), `currency`, `duration` (`once` \| `forever` \| `repeating`), `duration_in_months`, `plan_codes` (empty = every plan), `max_redemptions` (null = unlimited), `times_redeemed`, `redeem_by`, `status` (`active` \| `archived`), `archived_at`, `stripe_synced`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

body.raw:
{
  "code": "{{donexusCouponCode}}",
  "description": "Founding partner — 20% off for 6 months",
  "type": "percent",
  "value": 20,
  "duration": "repeating",
  "duration_in_months": 6,
  "plan_codes": [
    "{{donexusPlanCode}}"
  ],
  "max_redemptions": 25,
  "redeem_by": "2027-06-30",
  "reason": "Partner programme launch"
}

request.description:
201 with the coupon. Creates a Stripe Coupon + Promotion Code so customers can type `code` at checkout.

| field | required | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | 3–40 chars, letters/digits/`-`/`_`; stored uppercase |
| `type` | no | `percent` (default) \| `amount` |
| `value` | yes | percent 1–100; amount in whole units, max 2 dp |
| `currency` | no | amount coupons must be in the platform currency (AUD) |
| `duration` | no | `once` (default) \| `forever` \| `repeating` (+ `duration_in_months` 1–36) |
| `plan_codes` | no | only these plans; every code must exist. Empty = all plans |
| `max_redemptions` | no | ≥1, null = unlimited |
| `redeem_by` | no | last day it can be used |
| `description`, `reason` | no | |

If Stripe is down it still saves, with `stripe_synced: false` and a `STRIPE_NOT_SYNCED` warning (it won't work at checkout until synced).

**Errors:** 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` / `PLAN_NOT_FOUND` / `UNKNOWN_FIELD`, 409 `COUPON_CODE_TAKEN`.

One coupon (code is case-insensitive).
**Coupon object**: `code`, `description`, `type` (`percent` \| `amount`), `value` (1–100, or whole currency units), `currency`, `duration` (`once` \| `forever` \| `repeating`), `duration_in_months`, `plan_codes` (empty = every plan), `max_redemptions` (null = unlimited), `times_redeemed`, `redeem_by`, `status` (`active` \| `archived`), `archived_at`, `stripe_synced`, `created_at`, `updated_at`.

**Errors:** 404 `COUPON_NOT_FOUND`.

Only `description` and `plan_codes` can be edited: **Stripe coupons are immutable**, so the discount terms (`type`, `value`, `duration`, `max_redemptions`, `redeem_by`) are refused here as `UNKNOWN_FIELD` — use *Replace coupon*.

Changes the discount terms by retiring the Stripe coupon and issuing a new one. Body = the full coupon (as *Create coupon*).
- **Same `code`**: rewritten in place; `times_redeemed` restarts at 0.
- **Different `code`**: the new coupon is created first, then the old one is archived.

Tenants who already redeemed the old coupon **keep their discount** (Stripe doesn't remove it from existing subscriptions). 201 with the new coupon + `replaced: { code, in_place, archived_code }`.

**Errors:** 409 `COUPON_ARCHIVED` (restore it first), 409 `COUPON_CODE_TAKEN`.
Stops the code working at checkout (deletes the Stripe coupon). The record — and every discount already granted — is kept.

Puts an archived coupon back into circulation by creating a fresh Stripe coupon with the same terms.

**Errors:** 400 `COUPON_NOT_RESTORABLE` — the terms are no longer valid (expired, fully redeemed, or >100%); `details.hint` says to use *Replace coupon*. 409 `COUPON_ALREADY_ACTIVE`, 502 `STRIPE_UPDATE_FAILED`.

**Permanent**, and only for a coupon **nobody has redeemed** (checked live against Stripe) — for cleaning up typos. Once used, a coupon explains why a tenant pays what they pay, so it can only be archived: 409 `COUPON_REDEEMED`. Returns `{ code, deleted: true }`.

item.name: Tickets
item.description:
Support tickets (Donexus's tenant → platform helpdesk: raised by a charity's staff, its donors, or its public support form). All tenants' tickets live in one database, so every tenant's tickets are readable — including suspended and deleted tenants' under `/tenants/:id/tickets` — and the cross-tenant queue can't partially fail.

- status: new | in_progress | on_hold | solved | declined
- priority: low | medium | high | critical
- category: technical_error | bug_report | feature_request | access_issue | data_issue | general | other | billing | account | feedback

**Comment visibility is enforced server-side.** `is_internal: true` (the default) = Calcite staff only, hidden from the reporter **and** from the tenant's own admins. `is_internal: false` = visible to everyone and **emailed to the reporter**. Optional `visibility: "tenant"` = the tenant's admins + Calcite, hidden from the reporter.

query.description: Optional: summary, reporter name or email

request.description:
Support-desk view across every tenant, newest first; each ticket carries `tenant_id` and `tenant: { id, name, slug }`. Tickets of soft-deleted tenants are left out; comments are omitted (see `comment_count`).

**Paginated:** `meta: { page, limit, total, pages, failed_tenants }` — `failed_tenants` is always `[]` in Donexus (single database), kept for contract parity.

**Ticket object**: `id`, `number` (per-tenant sequence), `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `summary`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `category`, `reporter: { user_id, name, email, kind }` (`kind`: `admin` = tenant staff, `customer` = a donor, `public` = no account), `assignee: { id, name, email, assigned_at } | null`, `resolution: { notes, resolved_at } | null`, `first_response_at`, `satisfaction: { rating 1–5, feedback, rated_at } | null`, `triage: { category, board_status, notes }` (Donexus's internal bug/feature board), `attachments[]`, `comment_count`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Detail responses add `comments[]`: `{ id, message, author_name, author_id, visibility, is_internal, email_status, created_at }`.

exec: if (res.data && res.data.id !== undefined && res.data.id !== null) { pm.collectionVariables.set("donexusTicketId", res.data.id); console.log("donexusTicketId =", res.data.id); }

body.raw:
{
  "summary": "Donation receipts not being emailed",
  "description": "Since Monday 9am donors are not receiving receipts after checkout. Card payments are succeeding.",
  "priority": "high",
  "category": "technical_error",
  "reporter_name": "Dana Reyes",
  "reporter_email": "dana.reyes+{{donexusRunId}}@example.org"
}

request.description:
Opens a ticket on the tenant's behalf. 201 with the ticket (detail shape). Saves `{{donexusTicketId}}`.

| field | required | notes |
|---|---|---|
| `summary` | yes | ≤300 |
| `description` | no | ≤20 000 |
| `priority` | no | default `medium` |
| `category` | no | default `general` |
| `reporter_email` / `reporter_name` | no | Linked to the user when the email belongs to this tenant (kind `admin`/`customer`), else recorded as an external report (kind `public`). **Default: the tenant's owner** (409 `TENANT_HAS_NO_OWNER` if none). Public replies are emailed to this address. |
| `reason` | no | audit |

Donexus tickets have no `module` field. Shows up live in the tenant's helpdesk and the Donexus console; **no email** is sent on creation.
Same as *List tickets (all tenants)*, scoped to one tenant. Paginated.

Counts for a dashboard: `{ tenant_id, total, open, unassigned_open, by_status: { new, in_progress, on_hold, solved, declined }, by_priority: { low, medium, high, critical } }`. `open` = new + in_progress + on_hold. Every enum key is always present.

Full ticket incl. comments (every visibility), attachments, reporter, assignee, resolution and satisfaction rating.

**Ticket object**: `id`, `number` (per-tenant sequence), `tenant_id`, `tenant: { id, name, slug }`, `summary`, `description`, `status`, `priority`, `category`, `reporter: { user_id, name, email, kind }` (`kind`: `admin` = tenant staff, `customer` = a donor, `public` = no account), `assignee: { id, name, email, assigned_at } | null`, `resolution: { notes, resolved_at } | null`, `first_response_at`, `satisfaction: { rating 1–5, feedback, rated_at } | null`, `triage: { category, board_status, notes }` (Donexus's internal bug/feature board), `attachments[]`, `comment_count`, `created_at`, `updated_at`. Detail responses add `comments[]`: `{ id, message, author_name, author_id, visibility, is_internal, email_status, created_at }`.

**Errors:** 404 `TICKET_NOT_FOUND` (also when the ticket belongs to another tenant).
Edit any of `summary`, `description`, `priority`, `category` (at least one). Fields not sent are unchanged.
`status`: `new` \| `in_progress` \| `on_hold` \| `solved` \| `declined`. See *Resolve ticket* for what `solved`/`declined` add. Optional `reason` for the audit log.

`assignee_id` (required): an **admin user of that tenant** (404 `ASSIGNEE_NOT_IN_TENANT` otherwise — donors and other tenants' users are refused); `null` unassigns. `{{donexusAssigneeId}}` is set to the owner by *Create tenant*.

The assignment appears live in the tenant helpdesk; Donexus sends **no assignment email** and does **not** change the ticket's status (matching its own helpdesk).

`message` (required, ≤10 000), `is_internal: false`, `author_name` (default "Calcite Support"). 201 with the ticket plus the new `comment`.

**Side effects:** the reply is **emailed to the reporter** (from the tenant's email identity; `comment.email_status` = `sent` \| `failed`), sets `first_response_at` if unset, and moves a `new` ticket to `in_progress`. Only customer-visible replies count as a first response.

`is_internal: true` — **the default**, so a note is never emailed or shown to a customer by omission. Visible to Calcite staff only: hidden from the reporter **and from the tenant's own admins** (stripped from every tenant helpdesk response). No email, no status change.

For a note the tenant's admins may see but the reporter may not, send `visibility: "tenant"` instead (Donexus's console-style internal note).

`solved` / `declined` record `resolution.notes` and `resolution.resolved_at`.

**Side effect:** the **first** time a ticket is resolved (and only if the reporter hasn't rated it), a one-time "How did we do?" satisfaction email goes to the reporter — unless `send_satisfaction_survey: false`. Response includes `satisfaction_survey_sent`.
**Permanently** deletes the ticket and its thread — the only hard delete in this API. The audit log keeps a `ticket.deleted` event (number, summary, reporter email). Returns `{ id, deleted: true }`.

item.name: Leads
item.description: Donexus's **sales CRM**: charities that asked about the platform (the public *Get started* / *Talk to sales* forms) or that staff added by hand. The same pipeline as the Donexus console's *Leads* screen — every change is recorded in the lead's stage history and the audit log, attributed to `integration:<key> (<x-actor-email>)`.

query.description: Optional: new | contacted | qualified | demo_scheduled | proposal_sent | won | lost
Optional: an operator id (see Lead staff) or unassigned
Optional: org name, contact name/email, tags
Optional: activity (default) | created | org | contact | stage | value | close

request.description:
Pipeline table. **Paginated**: `meta: { page, limit, total, pages, sort: { key, dir }, new_count }` — `new_count` = unworked non-spam leads (badge).

**Lead object** (list rows): `id`, `org_name`, `org_website`, `vertical` (`general` \| `muslim`), `country`, `contact: { name, email, phone, role }`, `stage`, `priority` (`low` \| `normal` \| `high`), `tags[]`, `deal: { value, currency, expected_close_at }` (`value` = annual value), `interested_plan`, `interested_billing_cycle`, `source`, `assignee: { id, name, email, assigned_at } | null`, `lost: { reason, note, lost_at } | null`, `converted_tenant_id`, `flagged_spam`, `consent_to_contact`, `last_activity_at`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, and on lists `tasks: { open, overdue, next_due_at }` (CRM follow-ups).

**Detail** adds: `message`, `cause_areas`, `staff_size`, `annual_budget_range`, `donor_database_size`, `current_tools`, `current_tools_other`, `challenges`, `challenges_other`, `timeline`, `decision_role`, `contacts[]` (other people at the org: `{ id, name, email, phone, role, note }`), `tracking: { utm, referrer_url, landing_page }`, `converted_tenant`, `conversion_mode`, `converted_at`, `activation: { sent_at, expires_at, opened_at } | null`, `stage_history[]: { from, to, by, note, at }`, `thread[]: { id, kind: note|reply, body, author, emailed_to, email_status, created_at }`.

**Stages:** `new` → `contacted` → `qualified` → `demo_scheduled` → `proposal_sent` → `won` | `lost`. `won` is set **only** by *Convert lead*.
Platform operators a lead can be assigned to: `[{ id, name, email }]`. Saves the first into `{{donexusOperatorId}}`. Leads are assigned to Calcite/Donexus staff — **not** to tenant admins.

Enum fields accept `""`/`null` to clear. Validation errors name the wire field in `error.details.field`.

`stage` and `assignee_id` are refused here (`UNKNOWN_FIELD`) — use *Move lead stage* / *Assign lead*.
`{ kind: "note" | "reply", body, author_name? }`. A **note** is internal (never emailed). Returns the lead detail + `email_status` (null for a note). Moves a `new` lead to `contacted`.

A **reply is emailed** to the lead's `contact.email`, signed with `author_name` (**required** for a reply — it's what the customer sees). `email_status`: `sent` \| `failed` (with an `EMAIL_SEND_FAILED` warning; the reply is still saved on the thread).

`{ stage, note? }` for any open stage; `{ stage: "lost", lost_reason, lost_reason_note? }` to close it lost.
- `lost_reason`: `budget` \| `timing` \| `chose_competitor` \| `no_response` \| `not_a_fit` \| `spam` \| `other` (required for lost).
- `won` → 409 `LEAD_WON_REQUIRES_CONVERT`: a lead is won only by creating its tenant (*Convert lead*).
- A closed lead (won/lost) can't move → 409 `LEAD_CLOSED`.
`{ assignee_id }` — an operator id from *Lead staff*; `null` (or `""`) unassigns. **Errors:** 400 `INVALID_ASSIGNEE` (not a platform operator).

Turns the lead into a charity on Donexus. Fields you omit fall back to the lead's own answers (`org_name`, `admin_name` ← contact name, `admin_email` ← contact email, `plan_code` ← interested plan, `billing_cycle`, `is_muslim_charity` ← vertical).

| `mode` / `billing_mode` | what happens | lead |
|---|---|---|
| `manual_provision` + `comp` (default) | tenant + owner created **now**, comped; the owner is emailed a set-your-password link. **201** | `won` |
| `manual_provision` + `send_link` | tenant + Stripe subscription created **pending**; the contact is emailed a link to pay. Goes live when paid | stays open until paid |
| `activation_link` | nothing created; the contact is emailed a pre-filled self-serve signup link (valid 14 days) | `contacted`, won when they finish |
| `manual_provision` + `charge_now` | **not available to API keys** (needs a card entered in a browser) → 400 `CHARGE_NOW_UNSUPPORTED` | |

Other fields: `admin_name`, `admin_email`, `slug`, `is_muslim_charity`, `is_comp`, `comp_reason`, `trial_ends_at`, `coupon_code`, `reason`.

Response: `{ outcome: converted | payment_link_sent | activation_link_sent, lead, tenant: { id, name, slug } | null, link, email_status }`. `link` is the emailed link, so staff can share it if the email failed (`EMAIL_SEND_FAILED` warning).

**Errors:** 409 `LEAD_CLOSED`, 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR` (e.g. the admin email already has an account, slug taken), `CONVERSION_FAILED`.
Every lead grouped by stage for a kanban view: `{ stages: [...], columns: { new: [lead], contacted: [...], … } }`. Rows as *List leads*. Capped at the 1000 most recently updated.

**Entry**: `{ id, action, actor, actor_id, tenant_id, tenant: { id, name, slug } | null, target_type, target_id, at, meta }`. `actor` is the operator's email, or `integration:<key name> (<x-actor-email>)` for API calls. `meta` holds the action's details (diffs, `reason`, Stripe outcome, …).
